verdict_reason: Revenue only +7.46% YoY and EBITDA +7.59% with margin flat at 17.52% vs 17.50% — operations grew mid-single-digit. PAT +29.00% is not operating: finance cost fell 32.63 to 25.98 Cr and the tax rate dropped to 13.8% from 20.6%. Strip those and this is a modest quarter.
positives: EBITDA margin 17.52%, up 139 bps QoQ from 16.12%
Finance cost down 20% YoY to 25.98 Cr
red_flags: Revenue up only 7.46% YoY and 0.86% QoQ — growth has stalled sequentially
PAT +29% YoY flattered by tax rate 13.8% vs 20.6% YoY
notes: Rs in Lakhs in the filing, converted to Cr. Current and YoY columns cross-foot exactly to printed Total Income, Total Expenses and PBT; QoQ column carries ~Rs 4-6 lakh of OCR noise in the expense lines (0.006% of base), so QoQ EBITDA is derived from printed PBT plus depreciation and finance cost less other income. Single reportable segment. Consolidated includes 5 subsidiaries and 1 associate; no minority interest.
